notes: Root cause (Ronin mainchain gateway, Aug 2024): the bridge upgrade added initializeV3 (which sets totalOperatorWeight) and initializeV4, but the deployer ran ONLY initializeV4. totalOperatorWeight stayed 0, minimumVoteWeight() became 0, and a withdrawal passed the operator-vote check with an EMPTY signer set, draining the reserve. The attacker forges no signatures (empty set); the bug is the zero threshold from the skipped initializer. The incident was a deployment mistake, so setup runs only initializeV4 for both variants; the VULNERABLE finalizer leaves the weight 0, the patched finalizer runs initializeV3's weight-init (Ronin's actual fix). Distinct from the March 2022 Ronin key-compromise incident (Group B). Sources: Verichains, SolidityScan, Three Sigma.
